Execution order: Markdown step 11 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 34 (Markdown 10/12 — Update agents_template.md and generated agent guidance). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Provide a deliberate path for existing design .md files and task path mentions to become official Adashi artefacts after the new domain is available.
Scope:
- Reuse desktop document creation/editor commands for explicit file import and normal MCP upsert for agents that already read a source file; no automatic directory scanning/import on project open or bidirectional file watcher.
- Preview selected source content, title, intended identity and links; preserve complete prose and report the original source path in the import result without turning source paths into identity or adding generated headers to the canonical body.
- Detect duplicate identities/import attempts and resolve relative links deliberately. Leave original files untouched unless a separately authorized cleanup is requested; never silently replace a hand-authored docs file with generated output.
- Offer or document a reviewable conversion of selected task file mentions into typed markdown designSpecificationLinks with current task guards, keeping useful task descriptions and existing links.
- Ensure generated destination collisions are explicit. Import writes through the same canonical adapter boundary and receives normal tokens; desktop and agents see the same new artefact.
Acceptance:
- Import a representative legacy design on each backend, open it in the editable panel, link a task/QA job and verify generated discovery.
- Repeat/reject a duplicate import, preserve originals and untouched task text, handle Unicode/code fences and report unresolved relative assets/links.
- Do not bulk-import this repository's docs or rewrite existing live tasks automatically as part of developing the feature.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.
